title: Establish HSA-eligible group health plan if appropriate
summary: Letting employees access HSAs through a group HDHP is a high-value benefit at low cost.
detailsHtml: Many employees don't realize the HSA's value. Owner contributions on behalf of employees (a "company HSA contribution") cost the business as a deductible expense and provide employees with tax-advantaged savings. A $1,000/employee/year company HSA contribution often improves recruiting and retention more than equivalent salary increases.
